minutes.title: Launch Readiness Sync for Lumen v3
minutes.summary: The meeting addressed the launch of Lumen v3 on November 17th, set a pricing increase to $12/month with a 6-month grandfathering period, and decided to reduce password reset link validity to 15 minutes. The payment system's failure rate must drop below 1% by November 13th, and a security risk remains with the password reset link staying valid for 24 hours instead of 15.

decisions.text: パスワードリセットリンクの有効期限は、リリースの15分前までに短縮されます。
decisions.speaker: Marcus
decisions.quote: The security audit found that the password reset link stays valid for twenty-four hours. The auditor recommends fifteen minutes. That one is non-negotiable. We reduce it to fifteen minutes before launch. and the reset link drops to fifteen minutes.

actions.task: 支払いの再試行バグを修正し、13日の金曜日までに失敗率をチームに報告してください
actions.quote: I will fix the payment's retry bug and report the failure rate to the team by Friday, the thirteenth.

actions.task: 祖父の価格について顧客メールを作成
actions.quote: Understood. I will draft the customer email about the grandfathered price,

actions.task: パスワードリセットリンクの有効期間変更を15分に実装する
actions.quote: I will have it merged by Monday, the ninth of November.

actions.task: 17日の朝10時に、打ち上げ日の戦室を予約してください
actions.quote: I will book it for ten in the morning on the seventeenth, and I will share the invite today.

risks.text: テスト実行の約4%で支払い画面が無効になります。
risks.speaker: Marcus
risks.quote: On the release date, engineering is confident about Tuesday, the seventeenth of November.

risks.text: パスワードのリセットリンクは24時間有効ですが、監査人は15分間の使用を推奨します。
risks.speaker: Marcus
risks.quote: The security audit found that the password reset link stays valid for twenty-four hours.

risks.text: 遅い接続を利用しているユーザーの中には、2つ目のリンクをリクエストする必要がある人もいるかもしれません。
risks.speaker: Marcus
risks.quote: The risk is that some users on slow connections may need to request a second link.

decisions: Payments failure rate must be below 1% by Friday 13 November or the release is reconsidered
Raise the pro plan from $9 to $12 per month
Keep the $9 price for existing subscribers for six months
Reduce password reset link validity from 24 hours to 15 minutes before launch

actionItems.task: Fix the payments retry bug and report the failure rate
Draft the customer email about the grandfathered price and send to Priya for review
Merge the password reset link change (15 minutes)
Add a line about the second link request to the help center
Book the launch day war room and share the invite

risks: Payments screen fails on about 4% of test runs
Users on slow connections may need to request a second reset link
